subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge, or should the browser Canvas action-ingress work land first as the canonical web A2UI contract?
rationale: This request spans product direction and a security boundary: it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Design after dashboard substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a security-reviewed bridge spec once the dashboard custom-widget host has a maintainer-approved landing path.

options.title: Make Canvas ingress canonical first
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66983, then adapt dashboard widgets to that approved browser A2UI contract.

options.title: Move the bridge out of core
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not a core direction, route the idea to an external plugin or ClawHub package once the necessary APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Design after dashboard substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a security-reviewed bridge spec once the dashboard custom-widget host has a maintainer-approved landing path.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current native plugin-tab precedent and is the strongest visible routing signal for whether this becomes a bundled dashboard capability.
